Finance Parties and with the consent of the Majority Lenders (being, for the purposes of this Agreement, the Majority Revolving Facility

into an amendment agreement to the Senior Facilities Agreement (and/or such other applicable documentation as may be requested by the
Company) to reflect any amendment contemplated by that clause. The Company and the Majority Lenders have consented to the amendment and
restatement of the Senior Facilities Agreement as contemplated by this Agreement and accordingly the Agent is authorised and has been
instructed to execute this Agreement on behalf of the Finance Parties.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.5in">(C)&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;Pursuant

by law) appointed the Company to act severally on its behalf as its agent in relation to the Finance&nbsp;Documents.</P>

IS AGREED</B></FONT> as follows:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>1.&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;INTERPRETATION</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">1.1&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;<B>Definitions</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">In this Agreement:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&ldquo;<B>Amendment Documents</B>&rdquo;
means this Agreement, the Restated Facilities Agreement and each other document or agreement to be entered into by an Obligor in connection
with the terms of this Agreement.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&ldquo;<B>Effective Date</B>&rdquo;
means the date on which the Agent has confirmed to the Lenders and the Company that it has received each of the documents listed in Schedule
1 (Conditions Precedent) in a form and substance satisfactory to it (acting reasonably) or receipt of such documents and evidence has

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.5in">(a)&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;the
principal or equivalent amount of any outstanding indebtedness of such person for borrowed money;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.5in">(b)&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;the
principal or equivalent amount of obligations of such person evidenced by bonds, debentures, notes or other similar instruments (other
than Trade Instruments);</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.5in">(c)&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;the
principal or equivalent amount of all reimbursement obligations of such person in respect of letters of credit, bankers&rsquo; acceptances
or other similar instruments issued by a bank or financial institution (except to the extent such reimbursement obligations relate to
Trade Instruments or trade payables), in each case only to the extent that the underlying obligation in respect of which the instrument
was issued is not an obligation of a member of the Group and would be treated as Financial Indebtedness;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.5in">(d)&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;the
principal component or equivalent amount of all obligations of such person to pay the deferred and unpaid purchase price of property
(except trade payables), where the deferred payment is arranged primarily as a means of raising finance, which purchase price is due
more than one year after the date of placing such property in service or taking final delivery and title thereto (or if the relevant
supplier customarily allows a period for payment, if later the date one hundred and eighty (180) days after the expiry of that period),
for the avoidance of doubt excluding where the payment deferral results from the delayed or non-satisfaction of contract terms by the
supplier, from a dispute carried out in good faith or from contract terms establishing payment schedules tied to total or partial contract
completion and/or to the results of operational testing procedures&nbsp;and excluding earn outs and other contingent consideration arrangements;</P>

in respect of bank accounts subject to netting, cash pooling, net balance, balance transfer or similar arrangements, only the net balance

provided in this Agreement, and (other than with respect to letters of credit or guarantees or Financial Indebtedness specified in paragraph
(g)&nbsp;or (h)&nbsp;above) shall equal the amount thereof that would appear on a balance sheet of such person (excluding any notes thereto)
prepared on the basis of the Accounting Principles.</P>

or ratios shall be calculated on a pro <B></B>forma basis after giving effect to such Limited Condition Transaction and <B></B>the
other transactions to be entered into in connection therewith <B></B>(including any incurrence of indebtedness and the use of
proceeds <B></B>thereof) as if they occurred at the beginning of the applicable Relevant <B></B>Period for purposes of determining
the ability to consummate any such <B></B>Limited Condition Transaction and/or the ability to constitute or incur <B></B>any
related Additional Facility Commitments. For the avoidance of <B></B>doubt, if the Parent elects to use the date of the definitive
agreements as <B></B>the date of determination of compliance, as provided above, (x)&nbsp;if any <B></B>such baskets or ratios
are exceeded as a result of fluctuations in such <B></B>basket or ratio (including due to fluctuations in Consolidated Pro Forma
<B></B>EBITDA) subsequent to such date of determination and at or prior to the <B></B>consummation of the relevant Limited Condition
Transaction, such <B></B>baskets or ratios will not be deemed to have been exceeded as a result of <B></B>such fluctuations
solely for purposes of determining whether the Limited <B></B>Condition Transaction and the related transactions are permitted <B></B>hereunder
and (y)&nbsp;such baskets or ratios shall not be tested at the time of <B></B>consummation of such Limited Condition Transaction
or related <B></B>transactions.<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

or receipt of such documents and evidence has been waived by the <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Majority
Lenders. The Agent shall notify the Company and the Lenders <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>promptly
upon being so satisfied. Other than to the extent that the Majority <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Lenders
notify the Agent in writing to the contrary before the Agent gives such <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>notification,
the Lenders authorise (but do not require) the Agent to give that <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>notification.
The Agent shall not be liable for any damages, costs or losses <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>whatsoever

<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">4.2</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 13pt"><B></B></FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Further conditions precedent</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">Subject
to Clause 4.1 (<I>Initial conditions precedent</I>), the Lenders will only be </FONT>obliged to comply with Clause 5.5 (<I>Lenders&rsquo;
participation</I>) in relation to a <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Utilisation other than one to
which Clauses 4.5 (<I>Utilisations during the Certain <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Funds Period</I>)
or 4.6 (<I>Utilisations of Revolving Facility/Additional Facility during <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>the

on or before the Business Day <B></B>before the proposed Utilisation Date (the </FONT><B><I>Proposed Utilisation Date</I></B>), for
<B></B>same day value, a proportion of the aggregate Loan requested, to the <B></B>Agent Account (the <B><I>Prefunded Amounts</I></B>),
which shall be the proportion <B></B>which such Lender&rsquo;s Commitments bear (in respect of the relevant <B></B>Facility)

shall apply) shall take effect on a cashless basis by way of the <B></B>novation of borrowing obligations in respect of the Loans
(or part thereof) <B></B>under Facility B specified in the relevant Debt Push Down Notice (the <B></B></FONT><B><I>Debt Push
Down Loans</I></B>) on the &ldquo;Effective Date&rdquo; specified in such Debt <B></B>Push Down Notice and (other than in respect
of a Debt Push Down <B></B>described in paragraph (a)(ii)&nbsp;above) in accordance with the Supplemental <B></B>Tax Structure
Memorandum. Accordingly (and without the requirement <B></B>for any consent, sanction, authority or further confirmation from or
by <B></B>any Finance Party), upon the &ldquo;Effective Date&rdquo; specified in such Debt <B></B>Push Down Notice, the following
steps shall automatically occur <B></B>simultaneously:<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">A
Revolving Facility Borrower (or the Company on its behalf) may request a </FONT>Letter of Credit to be issued by delivery to the
Agent of a duly completed <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Utilisation Request not later than the
Specified Time.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">6.3</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 13pt"><B></B></FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Completion of a Utilisation
Request for Letters of Credit</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">Each
Utilisation Request for a Letter of Credit is irrevocable and will not be </FONT>regarded as having been duly completed unless:<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

become an Issuing Bank for the <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>purposes of this Agreement upon notifying
the Agent and the Company that it <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>has so agreed to be an Issuing
Bank and acceding to this Agreement and the <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Intercreditor Agreement
as an Issuing Bank and on making that notification that <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Lender shall
become bound by the terms of this Agreement as an Issuing Bank.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(vii)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B><I></I></B>any insolvency or similar proceedings.<B><I></I></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">7.4</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 13pt"><B></B></FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Cash collateral by Non-Acceptable
L/C Lender</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(a)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>If, at any time, a Lender under a Revolving Facility is a Non-Acceptable <B></B>L/C Lender,
the Issuing Bank may, by notice to that Lender, request that <B></B>Lender to pay and that Lender shall pay, on or prior to the date
falling 5 <B></B>(five) Business Days after the request by the Issuing Bank, an amount <B></B>equal to that Lender&rsquo;s
L/C Proportion of the outstanding amount of a <B></B>Letter of Credit and in the currency of that Letter of Credit to an interest-<B></B>bearing
account held in the name of that Lender with the Issuing Bank.<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(b)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>The Non-Acceptable L/C Lender to whom a request has been made in <B></B>accordance with
paragraph (a)&nbsp;above shall enter into a security document <B></B>or other form of collateral arrangement over the account, in
form and <B></B>substance satisfactory to the Issuing Bank but consistent with the <B></B>principles in paragraph (iii)&nbsp;of
the interpretation of &ldquo;<I>cash cover</I>&rdquo;, as <B></B>collateral for any amounts due and payable under the Finance Documents
<B></B>by that Lender to the Issuing Bank in respect of that Letter of Credit.<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(c)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>Subject to paragraph (f)&nbsp;below, until no amount is or may be outstanding <B></B>under
that Letter of Credit, withdrawals from the account may only be <B></B>made to pay to the Issuing Bank amounts due and payable to
the Issuing <B></B>Bank by the Non-Acceptable L/C Lender under the Finance Documents <B></B>in respect of that Letter of Credit
or as contemplated by Clause 6.11 <B></B>(<I>Effect of Termination Date</I>).<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(d)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>Each Lender under a Revolving Facility shall notify the Agent:<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(i)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B><I></I></B>other than in the case of an Original Lender, on any date on which <B><I></I></B>such
Lender becomes such a Lender in accordance with Clause <B><I></I></B>2.3 (<I>Increase</I>) or Clause 29 (<I>Changes to the Lenders</I>)
whether it is <B><I></I></B>a Non-Acceptable L/C Lender within paragraph <B><I></I></B>(a)&nbsp;of the definition thereof; and<B><I></I></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(ii)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B><I></I></B>as soon as practicable upon becoming aware of the same, that it <B><I></I></B>has
become a Non-Acceptable L/C Lender,<B><I></I></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">and
as indicated in Part&nbsp;II of Schedule 1 (<I>The Original Parties</I>), in a </FONT>Transfer Certificate, in an Assignment Agreement
or in an Increase <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Confirmation to that effect will constitute a notice
under paragraph (d)(i)&nbsp;<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>above to the Agent.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(c)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>To the extent that a Borrower has provided cash cover in accordance with <B></B>this

Obligor or the Company will be entitled to any right of contribution or </FONT>indemnity from any Finance Party in respect of any

<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">7.7</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 13pt"><B></B></FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Lender as Issuing Bank</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">A
Lender which is also an Issuing Bank shall be treated as a separate entity in </FONT>those capacities and capable, as a Lender, of
contracting with itself as an Issuing <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Bank.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">7.8</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 13pt"><B></B></FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Existing Letters of Credit</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">Notwithstanding
any provision of this Agreement to the contrary, a Borrower (or </FONT>the Company on its behalf) may by notice in writing to the
Agent prior to the <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Closing Date in relation to an Existing Target
Letter of Credit (including in each <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>case in any Utilisation Request)
request that any Existing Target Letter of Credit <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>issued by the Issuing
Bank be deemed a Letter of Credit issued and established <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>under a
Revolving Facility and with effect from the date specified in such notice <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>(being
a date falling within the Availability Period of the relevant Revolving <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Facility)
that any such Existing Letter of Credit shall be a Letter of Credit for all <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>purposes
under this Agreement, subject to the Agent having received notification <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>in
writing from the Issuing Bank that it agrees to the Existing Letter of Credit <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>being
a Letter of Credit for all purposes under this Agreement.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">8.2</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 13pt"><B></B></FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Unavailability of a currency</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">If before the Specified Time on any
Quotation Day:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(a)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>a Lender notifies the Agent that an Optional Currency requested under <B></B>paragraph
(a)&nbsp;of Clause 4.3<B> </B>(<I>Conditions relating to Optional Currencies</I>) is not readily available to it in the amount
required; or<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(b)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>a Lender notifies the Agent that compliance with its obligation to <B></B>participate
in a Loan in an Optional Currency requested under paragraph <B></B>(a)(iv)&nbsp;of Clause 4.3<B> </B>(<I>Conditions
relating to Optional Currencies</I>) would contravene a law or regulation applicable to it,<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">the
Agent will give notice to the relevant Borrower (or the Company on its </FONT>behalf) to that effect by the Specified Time on that
day. In this event, any <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Lender that gives notice pursuant to this
Clause 8.2 will be required to participate <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>in the Loan in the Base
Currency (in an amount equal to that Lender&rsquo;s proportion <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>of
the Base Currency Amount, or in respect of a Rollover Loan, an amount equal <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>to
that Lender&rsquo;s proportion of the Base Currency Amount of the Rollover Loan <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>that
is due to be made) and its participation will be treated as a Separate Loan <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>denominated
in the Base Currency during that Interest Period.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">8.3</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 13pt"><B></B></FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Agent&rsquo;s calculations</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">Each
Lender&rsquo;s participation in a Loan will be determined in accordance with </FONT>paragraph (b)&nbsp;of Clause 5.5 (<I>Lenders&rsquo;
participation</I>).<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B>9.</B></FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 14pt"><B></B></FONT><B><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Ancillary Facilities</FONT></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">9.1</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 13pt"><B></B></FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Type of Facility</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">An
Ancillary Facility or Fronted Ancillary Facility may be by way of any of the </FONT>following (or any combination of the following):<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(a)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>an overdraft, cheque clearing, automatic payment or other current account <B></B>facility;<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(b)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>a guarantee, bonding or documentary or stand-by letter of credit facility;<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(c)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>a short term loan facility;<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(d)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>a derivatives facility;<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(e)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>a foreign exchange facility;<B></B>&#9;and</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(f)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>any other facility or accommodation as may be required or desirable in <B></B>connection
with the business of the Group and which is agreed by the <B></B>Company and the relevant Ancillary Lender or Fronting Ancillary
Lender <B></B>(as the case may be).<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(f)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>In relation to an Ancillary Facility or Fronted Ancillary Facility which <B></B>comprises

<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">9.11</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 13pt"><B></B></FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Adjustments required in
relation to Ancillary Facilities</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">The
Agent may, by notice in writing to the relevant Revolving Facility Lenders, </FONT>reallocate drawn and undrawn Revolving Facility
Commitments at the end of an <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Interest Period among relevant Revolving
Facility Lenders as may be necessary <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>to ensure that any relevant
Revolving Facility Lender that intends to enter into an <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Ancillary
Facility has an undrawn Commitment under the relevant Revolving <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Facility
sufficient to allow it to enter into such Ancillary Facility, <B>provided that</B> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>for
the avoidance of doubt no such reallocation may increase any Revolving <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Facility
Lender&rsquo;s Revolving Facility Commitment.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">9.12</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 13pt"><B></B></FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Adjustment for Ancillary
Facilities upon acceleration</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(a)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>In this Clause 9.12:<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><B><I>Revolving
Outstandings</I></B></FONT> means, in relation to a Lender, the aggregate of the <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>equivalent
in the Base Currency of (i)&nbsp;its participation in each Revolving Facility <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Utilisation
then outstanding under a particular Revolving Facility (together with <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>the
aggregate amount of all accrued interest, fees and commission owed to it as a <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Lender
under such Revolving Facility), and (ii)&nbsp;if the Lender is also an Ancillary <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Lender
or Fronted Ancillary Lender or Fronting Ancillary Lender (as the case <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>may
be), the Ancillary Outstandings in respect of the Ancillary Facilities or the <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Fronted
Ancillary Facilities, attributable to that Ancillary Lender (or its Affiliate) <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>or
to its Fronting Ancillary Commitment or Fronting Ancillary Commitment <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>(together
with the aggregate amount of all accrued interest, fees and commission <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>owed
(or attributable) to it or to its Affiliate in such capacity).<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><B><I>Total
Revolving Outstandings</I></B></FONT> means the aggregate of all Revolving <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Outstandings.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(b)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>If a Declared Default or a Revolving Facility Declared Default occurs, <B></B>each Lender,
each Ancillary Lender and each Fronting Ancillary Lender <B></B>or Fronted Ancillary Lender shall promptly adjust (by making or receiving
<B></B>(as the case may be) corresponding transfers of rights and obligations <B></B>under the Finance Documents relating
to Revolving Outstandings) their <B></B>claims in respect of amounts outstanding to them under the relevant <B></B>Revolving
Facility, each Ancillary Facility and each Fronted Ancillary <B></B>Facility to the extent necessary to ensure that after such transfers
the <B></B>Revolving Outstandings of each Lender bear the same proportion to the <B></B>relevant Total Revolving Outstandings
as such Lender&rsquo;s relevant <B></B>Revolving Facility Commitment bears to the relevant Total Revolving <B></B>Facility Commitments,
each as at the date the notice of such Declared <B></B>Default or Revolving Facility Declared Default is served under Clause <B></B>28.15
(<I>Acceleration</I>).<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

Ancillary <B></B>Facility or Fronted Ancillary Facility shall set-off any liabilities owing to <B></B>it under such overdraft

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">Notwithstanding
any provision of this Agreement to the contrary, a Borrower (or </FONT>the Company on its behalf) may by notice in writing to the

under the relevant Revolving Facility) and with effect from the date <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>specified

an Ancillary Facility for all purposes under this Agreement, subject to the <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Agent
having received notification in writing from the Ancillary Lender <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>concerned
(or, as the case may be, the Affiliate of the Lender concerned) that it <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>agrees
to that Existing Ancillary Facility being an Ancillary Facility for all <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>purposes
under this Agreement.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

in <B></B>acting as the Fronting Ancillary Lender under any Fronted Ancillary <B></B>Facility and which at the date of demand

<B></B>reimburse any Fronted Ancillary Lender for any payment it makes to the <B></B>Fronting Ancillary Lender under paragraph

<TD STYLE="width: 1.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(B)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">if the amount of the maturing Revolving Facility Loan is equal to or less than the aggregate
amount of the new Revolving Facility Loans:</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 2in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(I)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><I></I>the relevant Revolving Facility Borrower will not <I></I>be required to make any payment
in cash; and</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 2in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(II)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><I></I>each Revolving Facility Lender will be required to <I></I>make its participation in the
new Revolving Facility <I></I>Loans available in cash only to the extent that its <I></I>participation (if any) in the new Revolving
Facility <I></I>Loans exceeds that Revolving Facility Lender&rsquo;s <I></I>participation (if any) in the maturing Revolving
<I></I>Facility Loan and the remainder of that Revolving <I></I>Facility Lender&rsquo;s participation in the new <I></I>Revolving
Facility Loans shall be treated as having <I></I>been made available and applied by the Revolving <I></I>Facility Borrower in
or towards repayment of that <I></I>Revolving Facility Lender&rsquo;s participation in the <I></I>maturing Revolving Facility
Loan.<I></I></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">(c)</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><B></B>At any time when a Revolving Facility
Lender becomes a Defaulting <B></B>Lender, the maturity date of each of the participations of that Lender in <B></B>the Revolving
Facility Loans then outstanding will be automatically <B></B>extended to the Termination Date in relation to the Revolving Facility
<B></B>and will be treated as separate Revolving Facility Loans (the </FONT><B><I>Separate <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Loans</I></B>)

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(d)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>A Borrower to whom a Separate Loan is outstanding may prepay that <B></B>Loan by giving
5 (five) Business Days&rsquo; prior notice to the Agent. The <B></B>Agent will forward a copy of a prepayment notice received in
accordance <B></B>with this paragraph (d)&nbsp;to the Defaulting Lender concerned as soon as <B></B>practicable on receipt.<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(e)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>Interest in respect of a Separate Loan will accrue for successive Interest <B></B>Periods
selected by the Borrower (or the Company on its behalf) by the <B></B>time and date specified by the Agent (acting reasonably) and
will be <B></B>payable by that Borrower to the Defaulting Lender on the last day of <B></B>each Interest Period of that Loan.<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

of such Non-Consenting Lender in the Facilities <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>together with all
interest and other amounts accrued under the Finance <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Documents in
accordance with Clause 41.5 (<I>Replacement of Lender</I>) below.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">12.1</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 13pt"><B></B></FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Exit</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">If (A)&nbsp;a Change of Control or (B)&nbsp;a
Sale, occurs (each an <B><I>Exit Event</I></B>):</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">(a)</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><B></B>the Company shall promptly notify
the Agent upon becoming aware of <B></B>that event and the Agent shall promptly notify the Lenders and Issuing <B></B>Bank accordingly
(the </FONT><B><I>Agent Notice</I></B>); and<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(b)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>each Lender shall be entitled to cancel its Commitments and require <B></B>repayment
of all of its share of the Utilisations and payment of all <B></B>amounts owing to it under the Finance Documents and each Issuing
Bank <B></B>shall be entitled to require that any Letters of Credit issued by it are <B></B>prepaid and cancelled, in each case
by notification to the Agent within 15 <B></B>(fifteen) Business Days of the Company notifying the Agent of the Exit <B></B>Event,
whereupon:<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(i)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B><I></I></B>the undrawn Commitments of such Lender shall, by no less than 5 <B><I></I></B>(five)

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">Any
prepayment under this Agreement shall be made together with accrued </FONT>interest on the amount prepaid and, subject to any Break
Costs, without premium <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>or penalty.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

Facilities</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">Subject
to Clause 5.8 (<I>Debt Push Down</I>), no Borrower may reborrow any part of </FONT>a Term Facility which is prepaid.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">

Facility</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">Unless
a contrary indication appears in this Agreement, any part of a Revolving </FONT>Facility which is prepaid or repaid may be reborrowed
in accordance with the <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>terms of this Agreement.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

with Agreement</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">No
Borrower shall repay or prepay all or any part of the Utilisations or cancel all </FONT>or any part of the Commitments except at
the times and in the manner expressly <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>provided for in this Agreement.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

to Clauses 2.3 (<I>Increase</I>) and 5.8 (<I>Debt Push Down</I>), no amount of the </FONT>Total Commitments cancelled under this

if later, after the date on which the relevant Lender became a Lender pursuant <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>to

administration or application of any law, regulation or treaty) or <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>any
published practice or published concession of any relevant tax authority other <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>than:
(i)&nbsp;a change in a Relevant Covered Tax Agreement (or the interpretation, <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>administration
or application of a Relevant Covered Tax Agreement) that occurs <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>pursuant
to the MLI and in accordance with MLI Reservations or MLI <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Notifications
made by (on the one hand) the MLI Lender Jurisdiction and (on <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>the
other hand) the MLI Borrower Jurisdiction (including, in circumstances <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>where

satisfies the MLI Disclosure Condition; or (ii)&nbsp;the United Kingdom <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>ceasing
to be a member state of the European Union as a consequence of the <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>notification

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 2.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>(II)<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;a

that falls to it by reason of <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Part&nbsp;17 of the CTA; or</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 2in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>(C)<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;a

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>(iii)<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;a

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>(b)<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;a

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>(c)<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;an

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><B><I>US
Qualifying Lender </I></B></FONT>means in respect of payments of interest by a US <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Borrower,
a Lender which is:<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>(a)<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;a
 &ldquo;United States person&rdquo; within the meaning of section 7701(a)(30) of the <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Internal
Revenue Code;<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>(b)<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;engaged
through a US office in a US trade or business with which such <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>interest
is &ldquo;effectively connected&rdquo; within the meaning of the Internal <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Revenue
Code;<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>(c)<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;entitled
to treat such payments as payments of &ldquo;portfolio interest&rdquo; within <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>the
meaning of Section&nbsp;871(h)&nbsp;or Section&nbsp;881(c)&nbsp;of the Internal Revenue <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Code;<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>(d)<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;a
Treaty Lender with respect to a US Borrower; or</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>(e)<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;otherwise

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">and

in the discretion of the <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>person making the determination acting reasonably
and in good faith.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(a)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Each Obligor shall make all payments to be made by it without any Tax <B></B>Deduction, unless a
Tax Deduction is required by law.<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(b)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">The Company shall promptly upon becoming aware that a Tax Deduction <B></B>must be made by or on
behalf of an Obligor (or that there is a change in <B></B>the rate or the basis of any Tax Deduction) notify the Agent accordingly.
<B></B>Similarly, a Lender or Issuing Bank shall promptly notify the Agent on <B></B>becoming so aware in respect of a payment
payable to that Lender or <B></B>Issuing Bank. If the Agent receives such notification from a Lender or <B></B>Issuing Bank
it shall notify the Company and that Obligor.<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(c)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Subject to the limitations and exclusions herein, if a Tax Deduction is <B></B>required by law to
be made by or on behalf of an Obligor, the amount of <B></B>the payment due from that Obligor under a Finance Document shall be <B></B>increased
to an amount which, after any Tax Deductions, leaves an <B></B>amount equal to the payment which would have been due had no Tax <B></B>Deduction
been required.<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(d)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">A payment by a Borrower shall not be increased under paragraph (c)&nbsp;<B></B>above by reason of
a Tax Deduction on account of Tax imposed by the <B></B>relevant Borrower Tax Jurisdiction if, on the date the payment falls due:<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(i)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">the payment could have been made to the relevant Lender without <B><I></I></B>a Tax Deduction if
the Lender had been a Qualifying Lender in <B><I></I></B>respect of such Borrower, but on that date that Lender is not or <B><I></I></B>has
ceased to be a Qualifying Lender in respect of such Borrower, <B><I></I></B>other than as a result of any Change of Law; or</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(ii)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">the relevant Lender is a Treaty Lender in respect of such Borrower <B><I></I></B>(or, in the
case of a Lender in respect of a Canadian Borrower, <B><I></I></B>any Lender) and the Obligor making the payment is able to <B><I></I></B>demonstrate
that the payment could have been made to the <B><I></I></B>Lender without a Tax Deduction had that Lender complied with <B><I></I></B>its
obligations under paragraph (g), (h)&nbsp;or (l)&nbsp;below; or</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(iii)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">in respect of a payment by a US Borrower, the relevant Lender is <B><I></I></B>a US Qualifying Lender
and the payment could have been made <B><I></I></B>to the relevant Lender without a Tax Deduction had that Lender <B><I></I></B>complied
with its obligations under paragraph (k)&nbsp;below; or</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(iv)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">in respect of a payment by a UK Borrower, the relevant Lender is <B><I></I></B>a UK Qualifying Lender
solely by virtue of paragraph (a)(ii)&nbsp;of the <B><I></I></B>definition of UK Qualifying Lender and:<B><I></I></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(A)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">an officer of H.M. Revenue&nbsp;&amp; Customs has given (and not revoked) a direction (a <B><I>Direction</I></B>)
under section 931 of the ITA which relates to the payment and that Lender has received from the Obligor making the payment or

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(vi)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">such Tax Deduction is imposed solely because this payment is <B><I></I></B>made to an account opened

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(e)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">If an Obligor is required to make a Tax Deduction that Obligor shall make <B></B>that Tax Deduction
and any payment required in connection with that <B></B>Tax Deduction within the time allowed by law and in the minimum <B></B>amount

Finance Party (in addition to and at the same time as paying the <B></B>consideration for such supply) an amount equal to the amount

<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(a)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Each Party may make any FATCA Deduction it is required to make by <B></B>FATCA, and any payment required
in connection with that FATCA <B></B>Deduction, and no Party shall be required to increase any payment in <B></B>respect of
which it makes such a FATCA Deduction or otherwise <B></B>compensate the recipient of the payment for that FATCA Deduction.<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(b)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Each Party shall promptly, upon becoming aware that it must make a <B></B>FATCA Deduction (or that
there is any change in the rate or the basis of <B></B>such FATCA Deduction) notify the Party to whom it is making the <B></B>payment
and, in addition, shall notify the Company and the Agent) and <B></B>the Agent shall notify the other Finance Parties.<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><B><I>Increased

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>(a)<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;a
reduction in the rate of return from a Facility or on a Finance Party&rsquo;s (or <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>its
Affiliate&rsquo;s) overall capital;<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>(b)<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;an
additional or increased cost; or</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>(c)<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;a
reduction of any amount due and payable under any Finance Document,<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">which
is incurred or suffered by a Finance Party or any of its Affiliates to the </FONT>extent that it is attributable to that Finance
Party having entered into its <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Commitment or an Ancillary Commitment,
Fronted Ancillary Commitment or <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Fronting Ancillary Commitment or
providing an Additional Facility Notice or <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>funding or performing
its obligations under any Finance Document.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(b)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Each Finance Party shall, as soon as practicable after a demand by the <B></B>Agent, provide a certificate
addressed to the Company giving reasonable <B></B>details of the circumstances giving rise to such claim and the calculation <B></B>of
the Increased Cost and certifying:<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

5 (five) Business Days of demand, reimburse each of the Agent and the <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Security
Agent for the amount of all reasonable third party costs and expenses <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>(including,
but not limited to, legal fees) reasonably incurred by the Agent and <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>the
Security Agent (and, in the case of the Security Agent, by any Receiver or <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Delegate)
(in each case, subject to agreed caps (if any)) in responding to, <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>evaluating,
negotiating or complying with that request or requirement.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">(a)</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">This
                                            Clause 23.15 shall apply to the extent a Guarantor incorporated <B></B>under the laws
                                            of Germany as a limited liability company (</FONT><B><I>GmbH</I></B>) or a <B></B>limited
                                            partnership with a limited liability company as its sole general <B></B>partner (<B><I>GmbH&nbsp;&amp;
                                            Co. KG</I></B>) (in each case, a <B><I>German Guarantor</I></B>) <B></B>guarantees the
                                            indebtedness of its direct or indirect shareholder or of a <B></B>Subsidiary of such
                                            shareholder. If the German Guarantor is a GmbH&nbsp;&amp; <B></B>Co. KG, each reference
                                            made in this Clause 23.15 to its Net Assets shall <B></B>refer to its general partner&rsquo;s
                                            Net Assets, and the same shall apply in <B></B>regard to any Capital Impairment of that
                                            German Guarantor.<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(b)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">The restrictions set out in paragraph
                                            (c)&nbsp;below shall not apply to the <B></B>extent:<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

                                            under any <B><I></I></B>Finance Document in respect of loans to the extent they are
                                            <B><I></I></B>passed on (directly or indirectly) to the relevant German <B><I></I></B>Guarantor
                                            or its Subsidiaries and such amount passed on is not <B><I></I></B>repaid;<B><I></I></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

                                            German Guarantor (as dominated entity) is subject to a <B><I></I></B>domination and/or
                                            profit transfer agreement (</FONT><I>Beherrschungs-</I><B></B><I>und/oder Gewinnabfuhrungsvertrag</I>)
                                            (a <B><I>DPTA</I></B>) with the <B><I></I></B>guaranteed Obligor, whether directly or
                                            indirectly through a chain <B><I></I></B>of DPTAs between each company and its shareholder
                                            (or in case <B><I></I></B>of a German GmbH&nbsp;&amp; Co. KG Guarantor between its general
                                            <B><I></I></B>partner and its shareholder) other than if such DPTA has been <B><I></I></B>cancelled
                                            or terminated to the extent the existence of such <B><I></I></B>domination and/or profit
                                            transfer agreement (<I>Beherrschungs-</I><B></B><I>und/oder Gewinnabfuhrungsvertrag</I>)
                                            leads to the inapplicability of <B><I></I></B>section 30 paragraph 1 sentence 1 GmbHG;<B><I></I></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TD STYLE="width: 1in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(v)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">The Finance Parties shall upon written demand
                                            of the relevant <B><I></I></B>German Guarantor to the Agent (on behalf of the Finance
                                            Parties) <B><I></I></B>repay to the relevant German Guarantor any amount which the <B><I></I></B>Agent
                                            would not have been entitled to enforce had the <B><I></I></B>Management Notification
                                            or the Auditor&rsquo;s Determination been <B><I></I></B>delivered in time or the difference
                                            between the amount paid and <B><I></I></B>the amount payable resulting from the Auditor&rsquo;s
                                            Determination <B><I></I></B>calculated as of the date the demand in respect of a Guarantee
                                            <B><I></I></B>Obligation was made.<B><I></I></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(e)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">If the Management Notification shows that
                                            a Capital Impairment would <B></B>occur upon payment under the guarantee, the relevant
                                            German Guarantor <B></B>shall realise, to the extent legally permitted and commercially
                                            justifiable, <B></B>all of its assets that are shown in the balance sheet with a book
                                            value <B></B>(<I>Buchwert</I>) that is significantly lower than the market value
                                            of the assets <B></B>to the extent this is necessary to fulfil its obligations under
                                            the guarantee <B></B>within three months after a written request by the Agent. If the
                                            relevant <B></B>assets are necessary for that German Guarantor business <B></B>(<I>betriebsnotwendig</I>),
                                            it will use its best efforts to realise the market value <B></B>by sale-and-lease-back
                                            or similar measures.<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

                                            condition of the relevant <B></B>German Guarantor as set out in the Auditors&rsquo;
                                            Determination has <B></B>improved (in particular, if the relevant German Guarantor has
                                            taken any <B></B>action in accordance with the mitigation provisions set out in paragraph
                                            (i)&nbsp;<B></B>above), the Agent may, at the relevant German Guarantor&rsquo;s cost
                                            and <B></B>expense, arrange for the preparation of an updated balance sheet of the <B></B>relevant
                                            German Guarantor by applying the same principles that were <B></B>used for the preparation
                                            of the Auditors&rsquo; Determination by the Auditors <B></B>who prepared the Auditors&rsquo;
                                            Determination in order for such Auditors to <B></B>determine whether (and, if so, to
                                            what extent) the Capital Impairment has <B></B>been cured as a result of the improvement
                                            of the financial condition of <B></B>the relevant German Guarantor. The Agent may consequently
                                            demand <B></B>payment under this guarantee to the extent that the Auditors determine
                                            <B></B>that the Capital Impairment has been cured.<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

                                            upon first demand and without <B></B>raising any defense or objection and without verification

the United States Investment Company Act of <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>1940, as amended
(the <B><I>1940 Act</I></B>).<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">The
undertakings in this Clause 25 shall continue for so long as any sum remains </FONT>payable or capable of becoming payable under
the Finance Documents or any <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Commitment is in force. Each of the
undertakings and obligations in this Clause <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>25 shall be subject
to the provisions of Clause 25.10 (<I>Alternative Reporting</I>), <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Clause
25.11 (<I>Public Reporting</I>) and Clause 25.12 (<I>Restrictions</I>).<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">In this Clause 25:</P>

delivered pursuant to paragraph (a)(i)&nbsp;of Clause 25.1 <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>(<I>Financial
statements</I>); and<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>
