<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><B><I>Capital
Lease</I></B></FONT> means, as applied to any person, any lease of any property <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>(whether
real, personal or mixed) by that person as lessee that would be classified <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>and
accounted for as a capitalised lease on the statement of financial position or <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>balance
sheet of such person for financial reporting purposes prepared on the <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>basis
of the Original Accounting Principles and which, for the avoidance of <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>doubt,
shall exclude any lease, concession, license of property or other <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>arrangement
(or guarantee thereof) which would be considered an operating lease <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>under
the Original Accounting Principles which is subsequently treated as a <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>finance
or capital lease as a result of any change to the treatment of such leases or <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>other
arrangements under the Accounting Principles.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

Facility (including any Replacement Revolving Facility that is a <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Springing
Covenant Facility) (in each case excluding: (i)&nbsp;any Utilisations by way <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>of
Letters of Credit (or bank guarantees) or non-cash Ancillary Facilities; or (ii)&nbsp;<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>drawings
identified by an Obligor as being drawn in connection with the <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>financing
of any Permitted Acquisition or capital expenditure (and, solely for the <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>purpose
of determining whether the Test Condition is met, the amount of the <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>exclusion
for the purposes of this sub-paragraph (ii)&nbsp;shall not exceed <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>&euro;105,000,000))
and less the aggregate amount of cash and Cash Equivalent <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Investments
held by members of the Group as at such date) exceeds 40 per cent <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>of
the aggregate of: (x)&nbsp;the Total Original Revolving Facility Commitments as at <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>the
date of this Agreement or, if higher, the amount of the Total Original <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Revolving
Facility Commitments which may be utilised as at such Test Date; and <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>(y)&nbsp;the
Total Commitments in respect of any Springing Covenant Revolving <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Facility

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">

<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">28.11</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Expropriation</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">The
authority or ability of any Obligor or Material Subsidiary to conduct its </FONT>business is wholly or substantially curtailed by
any seizure, expropriation, <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>nationalisation, intervention, restriction
or other action by any governmental, <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>regulatory or other authority
in each case to an extent which would have a <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Material Adverse Effect.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">28.12</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Similar events elsewhere</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">There
occurs in relation to any Relevant Entity or any of their respective material </FONT>assets in any other applicable jurisdiction
in which any Relevant Entity is <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>incorporated or carries on business
or the Group conducts a material part of its <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>principal business or
has material assets in, or to the jurisdiction of whose courts <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>it
or any of its assets is subject, any event which corresponds in that jurisdiction <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>with
any of those mentioned in Clauses 28.7 (<I>Insolvency</I>) to 28.8 (<I>Insolvency Proceedings</I>) (each inclusive) (in each case subject
to equivalent qualifications, <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>materiality and exceptions) set out
therein.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">28.13</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Litigation</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">Any
litigation, arbitration, or administrative or regulatory proceeding is </FONT>commenced by or against a Relevant Entity or any of
its assets which is <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>reasonably likely to be adversely determined
against that Relevant Entity and <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>which would, if adversely determined,
have a Material Adverse Effect.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

Agent shall, as soon as reasonably practicable after it has executed a Transfer </FONT>Certificate, an Assignment Agreement, Additional
Facility Notice, Additional <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Facility Lender Accession Notice, an
Increase Confirmation or Refinancing <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Amendment, send to the Company,
a copy of that Transfer Certificate, <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Assignment Agreement, Additional
Facility Notice, Additional Facility Lender <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Accession Notice,&nbsp;Increase
Confirmation or Refinancing Amendment. The Agent <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>shall provide, upon
the request of the Company, in relation to any specified <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Transfer
Certificate, Assignment Agreement, Additional Facility Notice, <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Additional
Facility Lender Accession Notice,&nbsp;Increase Confirmation or <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Refinancing
Amendment, a copy of such document to the Company within 5 <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>(five)
Business Days of receipt of such request.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

consent from the Parent or any <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Obligor, at any time charge, assign
or otherwise create Security in or over <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>(whether by way of collateral
or otherwise) all or any of its rights under any <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Finance Document
to secure obligations of that Lender including, without <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>limitation:<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(b)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">in the case of any Lender which is a fund, any charge, assignment or <B></B>other Security granted

own all or any <B></B>part of the share capital of an entity that is, a Lender or a party to a Debt <B></B>Purchase Transaction

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">(b)</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">A member of the Group or an Unrestricted Subsidiary

Lenders</I>), a participation in any Term Loan and any related <B></B>Commitment where:<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(i)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">such purchase is made for a consideration of less than par;<B><I></I></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TD STYLE="width: 1in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(ii)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">such purchase is made using one of the processes set out at <B><I></I></B>paragraphs (c)&nbsp;and

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">(i)</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">Prior to 11am on a given Business Day (the </FONT><B><I>Solicitation
day</I></B>), the <B><I></I></B>relevant Purchaser or a financial institution acting on its behalf <B><I></I></B>(the <B><I>Purchase
Agent</I></B>) will approach at the same time each Lender <B><I></I></B>which participates in the relevant Term Facilities to invite
them to <B><I></I></B>offer to sell to the relevant Purchaser, an amount of their <B><I></I></B>participation in one or more
Term Facilities. Any Lender wishing <B><I></I></B>to make such an offer shall, by 11am on the second Business Day <B><I></I></B>following
such Solicitation day, communicate to the Purchase <B><I></I></B>Agent details of the amount of its participations, and in which
<B><I></I></B>Term Facilities, it is offering to sell and the price at which it is <B><I></I></B>offering to sell such participations.
Any such offer shall be <B><I></I></B>irrevocable until 11am on the third Business Day following such <B><I></I></B>Solicitation
day and shall be capable of acceptance by the relevant <B><I></I></B>Purchaser on or before such time by communicating its acceptance
<B><I></I></B>in writing to the Purchase Agent or, if it is the Purchase Agent, <B><I></I></B>the relevant Lenders. The Purchase
Agent (if someone other than <B><I></I></B>the Purchaser) will communicate to the relevant Lenders which <B><I></I></B>offers
have been accepted by 12 noon on the third Business Day <B><I></I></B>following such Solicitation day. In any event by 11am on the
<B><I></I></B>fourth Business Day following such Solicitation day, the <B><I></I></B>Purchaser shall notify the Agent of the
amounts of the <B><I></I></B>participations purchased through the relevant Solicitation Process <B><I></I></B>and the identity
of the Term Facilities to which they relate. The Agent shall disclose such information to <B><I></I></B>any Lender that requests
such disclosure.<B><I></I></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">(i)</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">A Purchaser may by itself or through the same
or another Purchase <B><I></I></B>Agent, at any time during the period commencing on the expiry of <B><I></I></B>the relevant
Solicitation Process and ending 30 (thirty) days <B><I></I></B>thereafter, purchase participations from Lenders pursuant to <B><I></I></B>secondary
market purchases and/or pursuant to such bilateral <B><I></I></B>arrangements with any Lenders as the Purchaser shall see fit, <B><I></I></B></FONT><B>provided
that</B> the purchase rate on such market purchases and <B><I></I></B>bilateral arrangements during that 30-day period may not exceed

and Indemnity</I>);<B><I></I></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(iii)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">in the case of a Borrower which is also a Guarantor (unless it is <B><I></I></B>simultaneously resigning
as a Guarantor in accordance with this <B><I></I></B>Clause 31.4), its obligations in its capacity as Guarantor continue <B><I></I></B>to
be legal, valid, binding and enforceable and in full force and <B><I></I></B>effect (subject to the Legal Reservations and Perfection
<B><I></I></B>Requirements) or such release is contemplated under the <B><I></I></B>Intercreditor Agreement whether or not requiring
a consent <B><I></I></B>thereunder; and</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">

Disposal Proceeds <B><I></I></B>will be applied in accordance with Clause 12.2 (</FONT><I>Disposal</I>) (in each <B><I></I></B>case
if and to the extent required by that Clause).<B><I></I></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(d)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Upon notification by the Agent to the Parent of its acceptance of the <B></B>resignation of a Borrower
or a Guarantor, that entity shall cease to be a <B></B>Borrower or a Guarantor (as applicable) and shall have no further rights or
<B></B>obligations under the Finance Documents as a Borrower or a Guarantor <B></B>(as applicable). For the avoidance of
doubt, if an Obligor ceases to be a <B></B>member of the Group pursuant to a transaction not prohibited by this <B></B>Agreement,
that Obligor shall automatically cease to be an Obligor for all <B></B>purposes and shall have no further rights or obligations under
the Finance <B></B>Documents as an Obligor, except that, where the Borrower or Guarantor <B></B>is the subject of a Third Party
Disposal, the resignation shall not take <B></B>effect (and the Borrower and Guarantor will continue to have rights and <B></B>obligations
under the Finance Documents) until the date on which the <B></B>Third Party Disposal or other Permitted Activity takes effect.<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">31.5</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Repetition of Representations</TD></TR></TABLE>

to it as at the <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>date of delivery as if made by reference to the facts
and circumstances then <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>existing.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">32.2</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Duties of the Agent</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(a)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Subject to paragraph (b)&nbsp;below, the Agent shall promptly forward to a <B></B>Party the original

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

</B>(<I>Cash collateral by Non-Acceptable L/C Lender</I>),<B></B> paragraph (a)&nbsp;shall not apply to any Transfer Certificate,

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">

manifest error. Each Lender hereby authorizes the Agent to set off and <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>apply

such capacity, the <B><I>Hypothecary Representative</I></B>) in order to hold any <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>hypothec
granted under the laws of the Province of Quebec and to exercise such <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>rights
and duties as are conferred upon the Hypothecary Representative under <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>the
relevant deed of hypothec and applicable laws (with the power to delegate <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>any
such rights or duties). The execution prior to the date hereof by the Security <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Agent
in its capacity as the Hypothecary Representative of any deed of hypothec <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>or
other security documents made pursuant to the laws of the Province of <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Quebec,
is hereby ratified and confirmed. Any person who becomes a Lender or <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>successor
Security Agent shall be deemed to have consented to and ratified the <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>foregoing
appointment of the Security Agent as the Hypothecary Representative <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>on
behalf of all Lenders, including such person and any Affiliate of such person <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>designated
above as a Lender. For greater certainty, the Security Agent, acting as <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>the
Hypothecary Representative, shall have the same rights, powers, immunities, <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>indemnities
and exclusions from liability as are prescribed in favour of the <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Security
Agent in this Agreement, which shall apply <I>mutatis mutandis</I>. In the <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>event
of the resignation of the Security Agent (which shall include its resignation <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>as
the Hypothecary Representative) and appointment of a successor Security <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Agent,
such successor Security Agent shall also act as the Hypothecary <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Representative,
as contemplated above.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

by the Finance Parties</FONT></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">No provision of this Agreement will:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(a)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>interfere with the right of any Finance Party to arrange its affairs (tax or <B></B>otherwise)
in whatever manner it thinks fit;<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(b)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>oblige any Finance Party to investigate or claim any credit, relief, <B></B>remission
or repayment available to it or the extent, order and manner of <B></B>any claim; or</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(c)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>oblige any Finance Party to disclose any information relating to its affairs <B></B>(tax
or otherwise) or any computations in respect of Tax.<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">(a)</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><B></B>Subject to paragraph (b)&nbsp;below,
if a Finance Party (a </FONT><B><I>Recovering Finance </I></B><I><B>Party</B></I>) receives or recovers any amount from the Parent
or an Obligor <B></B>other than in accordance with Clause 35 (<I>Payment Mechanics</I>) (a <B><I>Recovered Amount</I></B>) and
applies that amount to a payment due under the <B></B>Finance Documents then:<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(i)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B><I></I></B>the Recovering Finance Party shall, within 3 (three) Business <B><I></I></B>Days,
notify details of the receipt or recovery, to the Agent;<B><I></I></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">(ii)</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><B><I></I></B>the Agent shall determine
whether the receipt or recovery is in <B><I></I></B>excess of the amount the Recovering Finance Party would have <B><I></I></B>been
paid had the receipt or recovery been received or made by <B><I></I></B>the Agent and distributed in accordance with Clause 35 (</FONT><I>Payment
</I><B></B><I>Mechanics</I>), without taking account of any Tax which would be <B><I></I></B>imposed on the Agent in relation
to the receipt, recovery or <B><I></I></B>distribution; and</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">(iii)</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><B><I></I></B>the Recovering Finance Party
shall, within 3 (three) Business Days <B><I></I></B>of demand by the Agent, pay to the Agent an amount (the <B><I></I></B></FONT><B><I>Sharing
Payment</I></B>) equal to such receipt or recovery less any <B><I></I></B>amount which the Agent determines may be retained by the
<B><I></I></B>Recovering Finance Party as its share of any payment to be made, <B><I></I></B>in accordance with Clause 35.6
(<I>Partial payments</I>).<B><I></I></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(b)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>Paragraph (a)&nbsp;above shall not apply to any amount received or recovered <B></B>by
an Issuing Bank or an Ancillary Lender, Fronted Ancillary Lender or <B></B>Fronting Ancillary Lender in respect of any cash cover
provided for the <B></B>benefit of that Issuing Bank or that Ancillary Lender, Fronted Ancillary <B></B>Lender or Fronting Ancillary
Lender.<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">34.2</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 13pt"><B></B></FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Redistribution of payments</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">The
Agent shall treat the Sharing Payment as if it had been paid by the Parent or </FONT>the relevant Obligor and distribute it between
the Finance Parties (other than the <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Recovering Finance Party) (the
<B><I>Sharing Finance Parties</I></B>) in accordance with <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Clause
35.6 (<I>Partial payments</I>) towards the obligations of the Parent or that <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Obligor
to the Sharing Finance Parties.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">34.3</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 13pt"><B></B></FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Recovering Finance Party&rsquo;s
rights</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">On
a distribution by the Agent under Clause 34.2 (<I>Redistribution of payments</I>) of </FONT>a payment received by a Recovering Finance
Party from the Parent or an Obligor, <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>as between the Parent or the
relevant Obligor and the Recovering Finance Party, <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>an amount of the
Recovered Amount equal to the Sharing Payment will be <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>treated as
not having been paid by the Parent or that Obligor.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

any part of the Sharing Payment received or recovered by a Recovering </FONT>Finance Party becomes repayable and is repaid by that
Recovering Finance Party, <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>then:<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">(a)</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><B></B>each Sharing Finance Party shall,
upon request of the Agent, pay to the <B></B>Agent for the account of that Recovering Finance Party an amount equal <B></B>to
the appropriate part of its share of the Sharing Payment (together with <B></B>an amount as is necessary to reimburse that Recovering
Finance Party for <B></B>its proportion of any interest on the Sharing Payment which that <B></B>Recovering Finance Party is
required to pay) (the </FONT><B><I>Redistributed Amount</I></B>); <B></B>and</TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(b)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>as between the Parent and the relevant Obligor and each relevant Sharing <B></B>Finance
Party, an amount equal to the relevant Redistributed Amount will <B></B>be treated as not having been paid by the Parent or that
Obligor.<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(b)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>A Recovering Finance Party is not obliged to share with any other <B></B>Finance Party

<B></B>if:<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(i)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B><I></I></B>it notified the other Finance Party of the legal or arbitration <B><I></I></B>proceedings;
and</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(ii)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B><I></I></B>the other Finance Party had an opportunity to participate in those <B><I></I></B>legal
or arbitration proceedings but did not do so as soon as <B><I></I></B>reasonably practicable having received notice and did not take
<B><I></I></B>separate legal or arbitration proceedings.<B><I></I></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(a)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>On each date on which the Parent or an Obligor or a Lender is required to <B></B>make
a payment under a Finance Document excluding a payment under <B></B>the terms of an Ancillary Document, the Parent or that Obligor
or Lender <B></B>shall make the same available to the Agent (unless a contrary indication <B></B>appears in a Finance Document)
for value on the due date at the time and <B></B>in such funds specified by the Agent as being customary at the time for <B></B>settlement
of transactions in the relevant currency in the place of <B></B>payment.<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(b)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>Payment shall be made to such account in the principal financial centre of <B></B>the
country of that currency (or, in relation to euro, in a principal financial <B></B>centre in a Participating Member State or London,
as specified by the <B></B>Agent), other than a Non-Cooperative Jurisdiction, as the Agent specifies.<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">35.2</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 13pt"><B></B></FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Distributions by the Agent</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">Each
payment received by the Agent under the Finance Documents for another </FONT>Party shall, subject to Clause 35.3 (<I>Distributions
to the Parent or an Obligor</I>) and <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Clause 35.4 (<I>Clawback</I>)
be made available by the Agent as soon as practicable <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>after receipt
to the Party entitled to receive payment in accordance with this <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Agreement
(in the case of a Lender, for the account of its Facility Office), to <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>such
account as that Party may notify to the Agent by not less than 5 (five) <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Business
Days&rsquo; notice with a bank in the principal financial centre of the country <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>of
that currency (or, in relation to euro, in the principal financial centre of a <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Participating
Member State or London) other than a Non-Cooperative <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Jurisdiction.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">35.3</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 13pt"><B></B></FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Distributions to the Parent
or an Obligor</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Agent may (with the consent of the Company or the Obligor or in </FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">accordance with Clause 36 (<I>Set-Off</I>))
apply any amount received by it for the <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Parent or that Obligor in
or towards payment (on the dat</FONT>e and in the currency <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"></FONT>and
funds of receipt) of any amount due from the Parent or that Obligor und<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">er <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>the
Finance Documents or in or towards purchase of any amount of any currency <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>to
be so applied.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">35.4</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 13pt"><B></B></FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Clawback</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(a)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>Where a sum is to be paid to the Agent under the Finance Documents for <B></B>another
Party, the Agent is not obliged to pay that sum to that other Party <B></B>(or to enter into or perform any related exchange
contract) until it has <B></B>been able to establish to its satisfaction that it has actually received that <B></B>sum.<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(b)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>Unless paragraph (c)&nbsp;below applies, if the Agent pays an amount to <B></B>another
Party and it proves to be the case that the Agent had not actually <B></B>received that amount, then the Party to whom that amount
(or the <B></B>proceeds of any related exchange contract) was paid by the Agent shall <B></B>on demand refund the same to the
Agent together with interest on that <B></B>amount from the date of payment to the date of receipt by the Agent, <B></B>calculated
by the Agent to reflect its cost of funds.<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(c)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>If the Agent has notified the Lenders that it is willing to make available <B></B>amounts
for the account of a Borrower before receiving funds from the <B></B>Lenders then if and to the extent that the Agent does so but
it proves to <B></B>be the case that it does not then receive funds from a Lender in respect of <B></B>a sum which it paid to
a Borrower:<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(i)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B><I></I></B>the Agent shall notify the Company of that Lender&rsquo;s identity and <B><I></I></B>the
Borrower to whom that sum was made available shall, within <B><I></I></B>60 Business Days of demand, refund it to the Agent;
and<B><I></I></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(ii)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B><I></I></B>the Lender by whom those funds should have been made available <B><I></I></B>or,
if that Lender fails to do so, the Borrower to whom that sum <B><I></I></B>was made available, shall on demand (or in the case of
the <B><I></I></B>Borrower, within 60 Business Days of demand) pay to the Agent <B><I></I></B>the amount (as certified by the
Agent) which will indemnify the <B><I></I></B>Agent against any funding cost incurred by it as a result of paying <B><I></I></B>out
that sum before receiving those funds from that Lender.<B><I></I></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">35.5</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 13pt"><B></B></FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Impaired Agent</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(a)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>If, at any time, the Agent becomes an Impaired Agent, the Parent, an <B></B>Obligor or
a Lender which is required to make a payment under the <B></B>Finance Documents to the Agent, as the case may be, in accordance with
<B></B>Clause 35.1 (<I>Payments to the Agent</I>) may instead either pay that amount <B></B>direct to the required recipient
or pay that amount to an interest-bearing <B></B>account held with an Acceptable Bank within the meaning of paragraph <B></B>(a)&nbsp;of
the definition of Acceptable Bank and in relation to which no <B></B>Insolvency Event has occurred and is continuing, in the name
of the <B></B>Parent or the Obligor or the Lender making the payment and designated <B></B>as a trust account for the benefit
of the Party or Parties beneficially <B></B>entitled to that payment under the Finance Documents. In each case such <B></B>payments
must be made on the due date for payment under the Finance <B></B>Documents.<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(b)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>All interest accrued on the amount standing to the credit of the trust <B></B>account
shall be for the benefit of the beneficiaries of that trust account <B></B>pro rata to their respective entitlements.<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(c)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>A Party which has made a payment in accordance with this Clause 35.5 <B></B>shall be
discharged of the relevant payment obligation under the Finance <B></B>Documents and shall not take any credit risk with respect
to the amounts <B></B>standing to the credit of the trust account.<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(d)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>Promptly upon the appointment of a successor Agent, as the case may be, <B></B>in accordance
with Clause 32.13 (<I>Replacement of the Agent</I>), each Party <B></B>which has made a payment to a trust account in accordance
with this <B></B>Clause 35.5 shall give all requisite instructions to the bank with whom the <B></B>trust account is held to
transfer the amount (together with any accrued <B></B>interest) to the successor Agent for distribution in accordance with Clause
<B></B>35.2 (<I>Distributions by the Agent</I>).<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">35.9</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 13pt"><B></B></FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Currency of account</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(a)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>Subject to paragraphs (b)&nbsp;to (e)&nbsp;below, the Base Currency is the currency <B></B>of
account and payment for any sum due from the Parent or an Obligor <B></B>under any Finance Document.<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(b)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>A repayment of a Utilisation or Unpaid Sum or a part of a Utilisation or <B></B>Unpaid
Sum shall be made in the currency in which that Utilisation or <B></B>Unpaid Sum is denominated on its due date.<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(c)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>Each payment of interest shall be made in the currency in which the sum <B></B>in respect
of which the interest is payable was denominated when that <B></B>interest accrued.<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(d)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>Each payment in respect of costs, expenses or Taxes shall be made in the <B></B>currency
in which the costs, expenses or Taxes are incurred.<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(e)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>Any amount expressed to be payable in a currency other than the Base <B></B>Currency
shall be paid in that other currency.<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">35.10</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 13pt"><B></B></FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Change of currency</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(a)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>Unless otherwise prohibited by law, if more than one currency or currency <B></B>unit
are at the same time recognised by the central bank of any country as <B></B>the lawful currency of that country, then:<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(i)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B><I></I></B>any reference in the Finance Documents to, and any obligations <B><I></I></B>arising
under the Finance Documents in, the currency of that <B><I></I></B>country shall be translated into, or paid in, the currency or
<B><I></I></B>currency unit of that country designated by the Agent (after <B><I></I></B>consultation with the Company); and</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(ii)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B><I></I></B>any translation from one currency or currency unit to another shall <B><I></I></B>be
at the official rate of exchange recognised by the central bank <B><I></I></B>for the conversion of that currency or currency unit
into the other, <B><I></I></B>rounded up or down by the Agent (acting reasonably).<B><I></I></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(b)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>If a change in any currency of a country occurs, this Agreement will, to <B></B>the extent
the Agent (acting reasonably and after consultation with the <B></B>Company) specifies to be necessary, be amended to comply with
any <B></B>generally accepted conventions and market practice in the Relevant <B></B>Interbank Market and otherwise to reflect
the change in currency.<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">35.11</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 13pt"><B></B></FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Disruption to Payment Systems
etc.</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 13pt"><B></B></FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">If
either the Agent determines (in its discretion) that a Disruption Event has </FONT>occurred or the Agent is notified by the Company
that a Disruption Event has <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>occurred:<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(a)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>the Agent may, and shall if requested to do so by the Company, consult <B></B>with the
Company with a view to agreeing with the Company such <B></B>changes to the operation or administration of the Facilities as the
Agent <B></B>may deem necessary in the circumstances;<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(b)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>the Agent shall not be obliged to consult with the Company in relation to <B></B>any
changes mentioned in paragraph (a)&nbsp;if, in its opinion, it is not practicable to do so in the circumstances and, in any event, shall
have no <B></B>obligation to agree to such changes;<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(c)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>the Agent may consult with the Finance Parties in relation to any changes <B></B>mentioned
in paragraph (a)&nbsp;but shall not be obliged to do so if, in its <B></B>opinion, it is not practicable to do so in the circumstances;<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(d)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>any such changes agreed upon by the Agent and the Company shall <B></B>(whether
or not it is finally determined that a Disruption Event has <B></B>occurred) be binding upon the Parties as an amendment to (or,
as the case <B></B>may be, waiver of) the terms of the Finance Documents notwithstanding <B></B>the provisions of Clause 41<B>
</B>(<I>Amendments and Waivers</I>);<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(e)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>the Agent shall not be liable for any damages, costs or losses whatsoever <B></B>(including,
without limitation for negligence, gross negligence or any <B></B>other category of liability whatsoever but not including any claim
based <B></B>on the fraud of the Agent) arising as a result of its taking, or failing to <B></B>take, any actions pursuant to
or in connection with this Clause 35.11; and</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(f)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>the Agent shall notify the Finance Parties of all changes agreed pursuant <B></B>to paragraph
(d).<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B>36.</B></FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 14pt"><B></B></FONT><B><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Set-Off</FONT></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(a)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>Subject to Clause 4.5 (<I>Utilisations during the Certain Funds Period</I>) and <B></B>Clause
4.6 (<I>Utilisations of Revolving Facility/Additional Facility during the <B></B>Agreed Certain Funds Period</I>), a Finance Party
may, at any time while a <B></B>Declared Default is continuing, set-off any matured obligation due from <B></B>the Company or
an Obligor under the Finance Documents (to the extent <B></B>beneficially owned by that Finance Party) against any matured obligation
<B></B>owed by that Finance Party to the Company or that Obligor, regardless of <B></B>the place of payment, booking branch
or currency of either obligation. If <B></B>the obligations are in different currencies, the Finance Party may convert <B></B>either
obligation at a market rate of exchange in its usual course of <B></B>business for the purpose of the set-off.<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(b)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>Any credit balances taken into account by an Ancillary Lender or <B></B>Fronting Ancillary
Lender when operating a net limit in respect of any <B></B>overdraft under an Ancillary Facility or Fronted Ancillary Facility shall
<B></B>on enforcement of the Finance Documents be applied first in reduction of <B></B>the overdraft provided under that Ancillary
Facility or Fronted Ancillary <B></B>Facility in accordance with its terms.<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B>37.</B></FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 14pt"><B></B></FONT><B><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Notices</FONT></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">37.1</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 13pt"><B></B></FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Communications in writing</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">Any
communication to be made under or in connection with the Finance </FONT>Documents shall be made in writing and, unless otherwise
stated, may be made <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>by electronic mail or letter.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(a)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>in the case of the Company, that identified with its name below;<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">

it <B></B>becomes a Party; and</TD></TR></TABLE>

below,<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">or

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">37.3</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 13pt"><B></B></FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Delivery</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(i)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B><I></I></B>if by way of electronic mail, when received in legible form; or</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(ii)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B><I></I></B>if by way of letter, when it has been left at the relevant address or 5 (five) Business
Days after being deposited in the post postage <B><I></I></B>prepaid in an envelope addressed to it at that address,<B><I></I></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">and,
if a particular department or officer is specified as part of its address </FONT>details provided under Clause 37.2 (<I>Addresses</I>),
if addressed to that <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>department or officer.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(b)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>Any communication or document to be made or delivered to the Agent or <B></B>the Security
Agent will be effective only when actually received by the <B></B>Agent or Security Agent and then only if it is expressly marked
for the <B></B>attention of the department or officer identified with the Agent&rsquo;s or <B></B>Security Agent&rsquo;s signature
below (or any substitute department or officer <B></B>as the Agent or Security Agent shall specify for this purpose).<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(c)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>All notices from or to the Company or an Obligor shall be sent through the <B></B>Agent
and notwithstanding any other term of the Finance Documents, all <B></B>notices and communications from the Company or an Obligor
shall be <B></B>sent through the Agent.<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

this Clause 37.3 will be deemed to have been made or <B></B>delivered to each of the Obligors.<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">If
the Agent is an Impaired Agent the Parties may, instead of communicating </FONT>with each other through the Agent, communicate with
each other directly and <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>(while the Agent is an Impaired Agent)
all the provisions of the Finance <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Documents which require communications
to be made or notices to be given to or <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>by the Agent shall be varied
so that communications may be made and notices <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>given to or by the
relevant Parties directly. This provision shall not operate after a <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>replacement
Agent has been appointed.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B>38.</B></FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 14pt"><B></B></FONT><B><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Calculations and Certificates</FONT></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">38.1</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 13pt"><B></B></FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Accounts</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">In
any litigation or arbitration proceedings arising out of or in connection with a </FONT>Finance Document, the entries made in the
accounts maintained by a Finance <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>Party are prima facie evidence of
the matters to which they relate.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">38.2</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 13pt"><B></B></FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Certificates and determinations</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">Any
certification or determination by a Finance Party of a rate or amount under </FONT>any Finance Document is, in the absence of manifest
error, prima facie evidence <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>of the matters to which it relates.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">38.3</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 13pt"><B></B></FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Day count convention</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">Any
interest, commission or fee accruing under a Finance Document will accrue </FONT>from day to day and is calculated on the basis of
the actual number of days <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>elapsed and a year of 360 (three hundred
and sixty) days or, in any case where <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>the practice in the Relevant
Interbank Market differs, in accordance with that <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>market practice.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(a)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>If, at any time, any provision of the Finance Documents is or becomes <B></B>illegal,
invalid or unenforceable in any respect under any law of any <B></B>jurisdiction, neither the legality, validity or enforceability
of the remaining <B></B>provisions nor the legality, validity or enforceability of such provision <B></B>under the law of any
other jurisdiction will in any way be affected or <B></B>impaired.<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(b)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>Without limiting the generality of the foregoing, if, at any time, any <B></B>obligations

any Finance Document <B></B>in respect of a Swap Obligation are or become illegal, invalid or <B></B>unenforceable in any respect
under any law of any jurisdiction by reason <B></B>of any Obligor not being a Qualified ECP Guarantor, neither the legality, <B></B>validity
or enforceability of the other obligations of such Obligor or any <B></B>other Obligor in respect of its obligations under Clause
23 (<I>Guarantees <B></B>and Indemnity</I>) or in respect of any other obligation under any Finance <B></B>Document under the
laws of such or any other jurisdiction will in any <B></B>way be affected or impaired.<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">Each
Finance Party agrees to keep all Confidential Information confidential and </FONT>not to disclose it to anyone, save to the extent
permitted by Clause 42.2 <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>(<I>Disclosure of Confidential Information</I>)

confidential information.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B>46.</B></FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 14pt"><B></B></FONT><B><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Contractual recognition

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">Notwithstanding
any other term of any Finance Document or any other </FONT>agreement, arrangement or understanding between the Parties, each Party
<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>acknowledges and accepts that any liability of any Party to any other
Party under <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>or in connection with the Finance Documents may be subject
to Bail-In Action <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>by the relevant Resolution Authority and acknowledges
and accepts to be bound <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT>by the effect of:<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(a)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B></B>any Bail-In Action in relation to any such liability, including (without <B></B>limitation):<B></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

amount due (including any accrued but unpaid <B><I></I></B>interest) in respect of any such liability;<B><I></I></B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TD STYLE="width: 1in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(ii)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B><I></I></B>a conversion of all, or part of, any such liability into shares or <B><I></I></B>other
